purpose: Fix the acceptance bars for SHOTS and SHOTS ON GOAL before either is modelled. Committed alone so the history proves the bars pre-date the numbers, as with the goalscorer model and the two team bake-offs.

targets.definition: did this player register one or more shots
did this player register one or more shots on goal

whyTheseLines: Chosen from DESIGN DATA ONLY (2022-23 + 2023-24 appearances, never the holdout) as the line with the most balanced base rate: shots over 0.5 occurs 46.6% of the time and shots on goal over 0.5 21.9%. Longer lines collapse toward rare events — shots on goal over 1.5 is 5.4% and over 2.5 is 1.2% — where a scoring metric is dominated by the base rate and tells you almost nothing about the model.
independence: The two targets are judged SEPARATELY against identical bars, and BOTH verdicts are recorded whichever way they fall. Passing one does not license the other, and a pass on either does not license assists or cards, which are untested.

population.rule: every player who APPEARED — started or came off the bench
population.honestLimitation: As with the goalscorer model, this conditions on participation and does NOT predict whether a player will play. Published rows stay conditional on starting until a lineup exists.

protocol.walkForward: by match date; rates are fitted STRICTLY on earlier-dated matches

warmup.rule: folds into the rates, NEVER scored

development.use: ALL hyperparameter search happens here and nowhere else

holdout.use: scored ONCE, after the configuration is locked

protocol.holdoutDisclosure: 2025-26 was scored once before, under the VOIDED goalscorer v1 run, for a DIFFERENT target (goals) with a model whose baseline was defective. No shots or shots-on-goal hyperparameter has ever touched it, and no shots outcome from it has been observed. This is disclosed rather than glossed: it is the cleanest holdout available for these targets, and the reader is entitled to weigh that themselves.

model.form: a shrunk per-appearance rate for the player's participation state, converted to P(count > line)
model.shrinkage: Bayesian pseudo-count k toward the positional rate for the same state, exactly as the goalscorer model
model.distributionIsAHYPERPARAMETER: Poisson OR negative binomial. This is declared rather than assumed because the design data says shots are OVERDISPERSED: variance/mean is 1.79 for shots and 1.33 for shots on goal, where Poisson requires 1.0. A Poisson fit will therefore be too tight in the tail, and the calibration bar should catch it. The negative-binomial dispersion is estimated by method of moments on the fit pool only.

baselines.definition: the league base rate for (position group x participation state), fitted on prior matches only
baselines.why: If player history does not beat a correct positional average, the model knows nothing about individual players.

baselines.definition: the player's unshrunk historical rate, positional as fallback
baselines.why: So shrinkage must earn its place.

primaryMetric: log loss on the binary over/under outcome
secondaryMetrics: predicted vs observed count of players clearing the line

acceptanceBars.note: ALL must hold on the HOLDOUT, per target, for that target to publish. Identical to the goalscorer bars — bars are not softened because a new market is harder.

bars.statement: model HOLDOUT log loss must be lower than the positional baseline's by at least 0.005
model HOLDOUT log loss must be lower than or equal to the raw-player baseline's
model HOLDOUT expected calibration error must be at most 0.020
summed predicted probabilities must land within 10% of the observed number of players clearing the line
the model must produce a probability for at least 95% of the appeared population

stoppingRule.statement: ONE sweep over the declared grid per target, on DEVELOPMENT only. A target that clears all five bars publishes; a target that does not is REJECTED and stays unpublished, and it is not re-specified on this corpus.

whatPassingDoesNotMean: It does not mean the model beats a sportsbook price. No player-prop odds are ingested at all.
It does not license assists or cards.
It does not answer whether a player will play.
